content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 2 JRF posts in total, one in each of two sub-projects. Each sub-project has its own investigator contact. The notice names Prof. Swadesh Kumar Pratihar as Principal Investigator (PI) and Prof. Himanshu Bhushan Sahu as Co-PI of the project, and prints phone numbers 9437391103 and 9437245625 for them respectively. A category-wise break-up of the posts is not printed.

rows.project_title: Green Hydrogen Integration and Microgrid Stability
Renewable Energy Integrated Secure Network Control and Protection Strategies

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, the essential qualification is a Post Graduate degree in basic science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests: CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship), and GATE. The selection process through National Eligibility Examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies and institutions such as DBT, DST, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc. The desirable qualification for both sub-projects (E4.2 and E4.6) is MTech/ME/M.S. in Electrical / Control Engineering / Energy Engg. or equivalent, relevant to the area of research, OR B.Tech / BE in Electrical / Control Engineering or equivalent, with a CGPA/CPI score of 7.00 (out of 10.0) and above and a valid GATE score, who can apply for admission to the PhD programme. The desirable experience / skillset for both sub-projects is: Power Systems, Microgrid Control, Operation, and Cybersecurity, Power Electronics and Drives, Active Power Filter, Renewable Energy & EV, AI/ML-based Control Applications, Battery, Hydrogen Storage, Fuel Cells, Supercapacitors. Candidates appearing for their final examination may also apply, but the qualifying degree result must be submitted by 31 December 2026. Where experience is prescribed, it is counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualification. The notice gives the age limit as "As per ANRF norms". The upper age limit is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice states a relaxation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, PwD and female applicants, and a separate relaxation for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates. The notice states that a Project Associate (PA) will be considered only if a JRF is not found suitable. The PA qualification is a four-year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agriculture Science, or a Master's degree in Natural or Agriculture Sciences, or BVSc, or B.Pharm, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognised university or equivalent. The PA pay is ₹30,000 per month (1st to 4th year). Candidates should check the official notification and the ANRF notification it refers to for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is shown as "NA" in the notice. The tenure printed is 04 years. After joining, shared accommodation is to be provided in the hostel as per institute policy. Selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The notice states that hard copies of applications are not required to be sent to the Institute. The application link is under NIT Rourkela Homepage, Faculty & Staff, SRICCE, Career Notices.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and the need of the project. NIT Rourkela reserves the right to fix higher criteria for shortlisting among those who meet the advertised qualification and project requirement. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. The scrutiny result is intimated by email on 7 December 2026. The test / interview is in person at NIT Rourkela on 9 December 2026, and selection is intimated by email on 14 December 2026. Selection and joining are cancelled in case of suppression of information or of the documents submitted.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: There are 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts: one in sub-project E4.2 and one in sub-project E4.6 of the ANRF-PAIR project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela JRF posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Rourkela JRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate degree in basic science, or a Graduate / Post Graduate degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a national eligibility examination of Central Government departments and agencies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Rourkela JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice states the age limit as per ANRF norms, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay of the NIT Rourkela JRF?
faq.answer: The JRF gets ₹37,000 per month in the 1st and 2nd year and ₹42,000 per month from the 3rd year onwards till completion of the project.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Rourkela JRF posts?
faq.answer: Send one PDF with the signed application and documents to [email protected], with a copy to the project investigator, and write "Advertisement No" on the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and candidates are shortlisted on merit and need of the project; the in-person test / interview is on 9 December 2026 at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Rourkela JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary / contractual and co-terminus with completion of the project, with a tenure of 04 years.

faq.question: Q9. Can final-year students apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates appearing for their final examination may apply, but the qualifying degree result must be submitted by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is Ph.D. registration required for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme.
